newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's Compania Nacional de Cerveza share jumps.
newsitem.headline: Peru's Compania Nacional de Cerveza share jumps.

text.p: Peruvian brewery Compania Nacional de Cerveza's stock jumped 10.14 percent Thursday to 1.52 soles in early Lima trade in strong volume of 1.45 million shares on rumors it would be included in a new holding company, brokers said.

The Lima equities market has been rife with rumors this week that a holding company would be created to manage the two sister companies -- Compania Nacional de Cerveza and the country's largest brewery, Backus y Johnston, brokers said.

"The merging with Backus should improve the CNC (Compania Nacional de Cerveza) share price because it will result in better distribution of the Pilsen beer -- the company's principal product -- which will in turn lead to an increase in sales," said Edwin Paz of local brokerage Divisas y Valores.
"The price of CNC has been depressed for several months, but its recent financial results have shown positive results," Paz added.

Compania Nacional de Cerveza's 10.14 percent rise after just under two hours of trade Thursday followed the share's 10.40 percent jump Wednesday, when its volume accounted for nine percent of total trade.
Trade in Compania Nacional de Cerveza Thursday dominated the market, with volume double that of benchmark Telefonica del Peru -- the second most heavily traded stock.
Officials at Compania Nacional de Cerveza said this week that the creation of a holding company with Backus is no more than a rumor.
Backus y Johnston was up 2.11 percent Thursday to 2.91 soles.
